headline: The guardian reads like game-feel now
lede: Double Dragon's blue seat already knew to rescue his brother — this pass makes you SEE it coming: speed lines on the rescue sprint, a flash and an arms-up where a grip breaks, a jab that sounds like technique, and a strut over every KO. All juice, every hash untouched.

notes.text: #2857 shipped (PR #2887): guardian glint, grip-break flash + relief pose, blue jab voice (jab_b) with a wider stagger wobble, and a 20-tick post-KO flourish — 15 new pins, two new named mutants (glint-deaf, flair-dead), ddragoncheck 168/168.

The ropes-phase leg caught a real bug on main: ANY keyboard key was stealing Jimmy from his CPU seat (the drop-in law's isP2 gate was missing) — fixed, with the seat state now pinned honestly in the browser fixtures that had leaned on the accident.
Follow-up polish pass filed for the QA lane: #2889 (glint at screen distance, relief/HUD tie-in, flourish through the step-back, KO squash, phone-mix ear check).
Juice discipline held: guard/relief/flourish/wob/gripFx never enter stateHash — a pin injects them all and demands the hash not blink.
